segments.name: Battery Manufacturing
segments.description: Designs, develops, manufactures and commercializes advanced lithium-ion batteries with silicon-anode architectures for consumer electronics, defense and industrial applications.
segments.evidence: Enovix Corporation (the "Company," "we," "us," "our" and "Enovix") is a global high-performance battery company focused on designing, developing, manufacturing, and commercializing advanced Lithium-ion, or Li-ion, batteries, including proprietary silicon-anode architectures, for smartphones, smart eyewear, defense, industrial and emerging edge-AI applications.

revenueModel.text: Customers including original equipment manufacturers and original design manufacturers purchase batteries for smartphones, smart eyewear, defense and industrial applications.
revenueModel.evidence: Most recently, we partnered with a top-tier mobile original equipment manufacturer ("OEM") on the development of our AI-1 TM smartphone battery, which demonstrated high volumetric energy density and fast-charge performance verified by an independent testing laboratory.

changes.text: In 2023, Enovix acquired Routejade, Inc., a battery manufacturer in South Korea, to vertically integrate electrode coating and battery pack manufacturing and expand product offerings to include lithium-ion battery technologies for defense and industrial…
changes.evidence: The Routejade acquisition enabled us to vertically integrate electrode coating and battery pack manufacturing and expand our product offerings to include lithium-ion battery technologies, including silicon-doped graphite solutions, for defense and industrial applications.

changes.text: In 2025, Enovix acquired battery cell manufacturing assets and facilities from SolarEdge in South Korea to further expand manufacturing capabilities.
changes.evidence: In 2025, we further expanded our manufacturing capabilities in South Korea through the acquisition of an adjacent battery cell manufacturing facility and related equipment from Solar Edge.
